page_note: 本页顶部是一张按五个地区分列的社交网络新闻使用比例横向条形矩阵图，下方为正文、TikTok 手机截图配两个环形指标（40%/15%）以及一个市场排行小表格。

heading.title: PROPORTION THAT USED EACH SOCIAL NETWORK FOR NEWS IN THE LAST WEEK – SELECTED REGIONS

panel_names: of 18-24s use TikTok for any purpose

components.evidence: network names on the left, bars grow rightwards inside grey tracks
no ticks or gridlines; only printed labels like `40%`, `57%` give values
percentages printed just right of each coloured bar end, on the grey track
each bar sits in a light grey full-width track behind the coloured bar
five side-by-side region columns: Europe, North America, Asia, Latin America, Africa
coloured headers `Europe`, `North America`, `Asia`, `Latin America`, `Africa` above each column
one shared row of category names (Facebook...TikTok) at left for all five columns
Facebook, YouTube, WhatsApp etc. brand logos precede each row label
`Q12B. Which, if any, of the following...` and `Note: Africa average is Kenya, South Africa, and Nigeria only`
regional bar matrix at top, donut pair mid-right, market usage table below it
left column body text runs level with the TikTok phone image and donut figures
bordered two-column table of flags, market names and `43%/15%` values under a caption
national flag pictograms precede Kenya, Thailand, South Africa, Peru, Mexico
heading reads `% for any purpose/for news` in the two matching series colours
colour-coded `% for any purpose/for news` sits above the table rows
`Q12a/b. Which, if any, ... Base: Total sample in each market (n = 2000).`
`40%` and `15%` printed at the centre of each donut ring
`(Across all markets)` note beneath the two donut rings

new_components.name: row_track_full_scale
new_components.evidence: each grey track is a fixed full-length 100% frame with the coloured bar inside it
new_components.why_it_matters: 读数只能靠印出的百分比或与灰色满格轨道的长度比，缺少刻度会让像素估值误差放大。

new_components.name: panel_color_encodes_panel
new_components.evidence: each region column uses its own single colour matching its header text colour
new_components.why_it_matters: 颜色不是系列而是面板标识，表格行必须用地区名而非颜色来定位数值。

new_components.name: donut_progress_indicator
new_components.evidence: single-value ring with big centre percentage and a caption sentence beside it
new_components.why_it_matters: 这类单值环图没有类别轴，值只能来自中心数字，行标签需由旁边说明句提供。

new_components.name: paired_values_in_one_cell
new_components.evidence: table cell prints `43%/15%` as two coloured numbers separated by a slash
new_components.why_it_matters: 一个单元格含两个不同系列的值，解析时必须拆分斜杠才能各自定位。

spot_checks.mark: the Facebook bar in the Latin America column
the YouTube bar in the Africa column
the WhatsApp bar in the Asia column

difficulty_notes: 三个值都以文字印在条形旁，读数本身没有难度（步骤2可忽略）；真正的障碍是定位：f1 是 8 行 × 5 个地区列的矩阵，44% 只出现在 Africa 列的 YouTube 行，而 Africa 的 Facebook 是 59%、Twitter 是 34%，若解析器把五列拼成一行或丢掉列头，44% 与 24% 这类两位数在同页还会与 f3 的 `42%/22%`、`43%/15%` 混淆。因此每个值至少需要「地区列名 + 网络行名」两个键，而列头是彩色文字而非表头单元，最易在 markdown 中丢失。
